summary: You can love in an open, original way when you reach for it. The capacity for a free, electric connection is there, available when you use it.
body: You can love in an open, original way when you reach for it. The capacity for a free, electric connection is there, available when you use it. Left idle, you default to what love is supposed to look like. But when you let yourself want connection on your own terms, you find the kind that doesn't ask you to shrink. The opening rewards honesty about what you actually want. Reach for it and love stops following someone else's rules.
gift: At your best: open and original in love once you choose it.
shadow: The trap: defaulting to what love is supposed to look like.
integration: Let love and values and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Good for fresh, original creative and social moves; unreliable for steady commitments.
do: Want connection on your own terms
Be honest about what you actually want
